title: Critique: biological naturalism is a form of dualism

statements.text: A theory with two very different kinds of biological phenomena, one with subjective ontology and one with objective ontology, is a form of dualism, which Corcoran called biological dualism. It does not explain how nature came to divide into subjective and objective properties.

sources.quote: a form of dualism, in that it involves two very distinct types of biological phenomena
